full_judgment: 4. On conclusion of the trial the learned Subordinate Judge. Thakurgaon has been pleased to dismiss the suit by his judgment and decree dated 28-5-1992 and being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the judgment and decree of the trial Court the plaintiff has preferred the Title Appeal No.19 of 1992 and by judgment and decree dated 27-5-1993 the learned Additional District Judge. Thakurgaon, has been pleased to allow the appeal by setting aside the judgment and decree of the learned trial Court and declaring the ex parte decree passed in the Other Class Suit No.1 00 of 1978 on 24-5-1979. by the learned Assistant Judge, Thakurgaon illegal, void, collusive and not binding upon the plaintiff- appellant also declaring the title of the plaintiff in the suit property directing the defendant No.1 to vacate the suit land by demolishing and removing structures and declaring also khas possession of the plaintiff in the suit land on eviction of the defendant No.1 as aforesaid.
